faqs.question: How much do terracotta tiles cost in Karachi?
faqs.answer: It depends on size, shape, finish, quantity and freight, so we do not print a fixed rate. Send your area and preferred tile on WhatsApp and we reply with a written, dated quote.

faqs.question: Why do terracotta tile quotes differ between suppliers?
faqs.answer: Quotes may use different sizes, thicknesses, units (per piece or per square foot), batch quality and freight terms. Compare like for like and get the unit and date in writing.

faqs.question: Is terracotta cheaper than ceramic or porcelain tile?
faqs.answer: It varies by size, finish and supplier, so there is no single answer. Compare dated quotes for the same area, and include fitting and sealing in the total.

faqs.question: Should I ask for a per piece or per square foot price?
faqs.answer: Either works if the unit is clear. Convert both to the same basis using the tile size, and ask the supplier to work the total from your measured area.
